fact: The Director General says online filing covers all taxpayers and nearly all taxes, bank-transfer e-payment works for all taxpayers of computerised centres, mobile money and cards are not yet supported, and electronic receipts rose from 2% in 2022 to 30% in 2024.
title: Hamadou Fall Dianka, directeur général des impôts dans l'Essor : "Le télépaiement accélère la collecte des recettes fiscales"
